note: P mixes a multi-package list (P1, P4 are close cousins with status pills and an add-form footer), a tabbed list with progress bars (P3), and a minimal dot-and-count header (P2), so it spans several information structures on one dark palette. Q is four single-parcel status panels with the same bottom-right toast, the same vertical timeline and the same Copy number / Open carrier / Dismiss button trio (Q2 and Q4 are nearly identical), differing mainly in accent color and title.
